parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search by customer name, email, or address fields

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending (e.g. -name, created_at)

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: Include archived customers: 0 = active only, 1 = archived only

parameters.name: table_specifications
parameters.description: Set to 1 to return DataTable column specifications instead of data

parameters.name: included[]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of columns to include in response

parameters.name: excluded[]
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of columns to exclude from response
